authority: This remediation is execution-authoritative over all prior iteration-007 contracts wherever it adds detail. Every replacement prepare receipt, execution spec, checkpoint metadata, execution receipt, validator, and test must bind all five contract file hashes.

end_directional_gates.forbidden_as_sole_evidence: scalar helpers, copied formulas, range-only assertions, or self-equality assertions
mutation_sensitive_cases: poison each of the four negative-target values at its inclusive END-delta, teacher-delta, and unique-argmax boundary and verify the production gate changes only beyond the boundary
poison each of the 20 positive-normalized END rows at and below the inclusive 1e-6 boundary and verify the exact ordinal is reported
construct the 31-row positive-raw population so the lower empirical median is exactly zero and then strictly positive, using the production lower-median path
place a large END decrease outside the 31-row population and prove it cannot affect maximum-decrease acceptance, then place it inside and prove it does
break each of the 43 teacher-END unique argmax controls through the production gate and verify the exact ordinal is reported
alter one bound membership or count and prove validation fails rather than silently recomputing a new population

execution_output_confinement.production_entrypoint_required: The real execution-spec/output preflight path that is called by execute before Adam construction, including the production output-directory validator.
execution_output_confinement.adam_guard: Patch torch.optim.Adam to raise and assert zero constructor calls for every rejected path case.
required_cases: canonical absent fixed output path passes preflight
existing file or directory at the fixed output path fails
dot, dot-dot, empty-component, separator, or noncanonical traversal fails

symlink, junction, or reparse point in any existing component fails using a real temporary filesystem object when supported, otherwise a production filesystem-attribute seam patched to the real reparse result
wrong but otherwise safe output path fails exact-value binding
execution_output_confinement.forbidden_as_sole_evidence: prepare-path validator tests or failures caused only by an earlier fixed-string mismatch that never reach the production execution-output validator

terminal_artifact_allowlists.production_entrypoint_required: The real checkpoint and status publication functions using a temporary directory and synthetic checkpoint payload.
required_filesystem_cases: accepted terminal contains exactly candidate.pt, accepted_receipt.json, and ACCEPTED
rejected terminal contains exactly candidate.pt, rejected_receipt.json, and REJECTED
zero-successful-step rejection contains exactly rejected_receipt.json and REJECTED
preflight failure leaves the output absent
pre-public-identity failure creates no canonical terminal claim and removes only owned staging
post-identity failure retains the same verified candidate identity, creates no replacement checkpoint, and permits only the matching rejected receipt-marker completion
opposite marker/receipt, extra file, overwrite, collision, or second checkpoint fails
terminal_artifact_allowlists.forbidden_as_sole_evidence: mocking the publisher itself or checking only an in-memory gate boolean without inspecting the real temporary filesystem artifact set

measurement_timing.production_entrypoint_required: The real stage full-batch update path and report builder with a tiny synthetic model/loss or mutation-sensitive seams.
sentinel_contract: assign distinguishable pre-step and post-step parameter or output sentinels
prove loss, policy loss, anchor contribution, entropy, and gradient evidence capture the pre-step sentinel
prove probabilities, values, safety metrics, parameter bytes, and optimizer state capture the post-step sentinel
prove every Stage-2 delta-from-stage-start uses one fixed post-Stage-1 snapshot rather than the preceding Stage-2 update
intentionally swap a pre/post seam in the test and prove the production validation rejects it
measurement_timing.forbidden_as_sole_evidence: checking only that measurement_timing contains the expected key names or prose values

implementation_rule.if_a_production_defect_is_exposed: Stop and report the exact defect before modifying production code. A further root-authored correction is required for any behavior change beyond adding strict receipt bindings for this remediation.

replacement_prepare.publication: Create exactly once with CREATE_NEW semantics only after all production-path tests and regression schedules pass. Preserve prepare v1 and v2 byte-exact.

forbidden: overwriting, deleting, or presenting prepare v1 or v2 as execution authorization
weakening production gates or path confinement to make tests pass
mocking away the production function that the test claims to exercise
changing hypothesis, training data, objective, model, update schedule, parameter groups, or thresholds
real 830-row optimizer execution, games, runtime smoke, packaging, promotion, submission, or same-iteration retry before prepare v3 passes independent audits
stop_rule: After the mutation-sensitive production-path tests and all regressions pass, generate prepare v3 exactly once and stop for another independent code and numerical-provenance audit before execution-spec authoring.
